userDescription:
## User Requirements
- Input parameters: keyword, page number
- Page operations & data to collect: 1. Use the search input box and the Submit button to search for contracts by the specified keyword.
2. Use the page navigation input box to jump to the specified page number.
3. After the page has finished rendering, open each item title link in the main result list in a new Chrome tab.
4. Crawl the detail page HTML and extract all key-value pairs related to the contract.
- Output structure: Array of contract. Each contract contains detail page html and varias key-value from the table in the detail page about contract.
